# Portal HTML Test Fixtures

Offline, sanitized HTML fixtures representing various Pakistani procurement portals and server responses for automated deterministic testing without live internet.

## Included Fixtures:
- `punjab_eproc/page.html`: Public HTML table structure from Punjab PPRA eProcurement with reference numbers, titles, and dates.
- `sppra/page.html`: Public listing from Sindh Public Procurement Regulatory Authority.
- `epads/page.html`: Federal PPRA EPADS portal structure.
- `tender_services/page.html`: Tender Services Pakistan aggregated listing.
- `cloudflare_challenge/page.html`: Cloudflare Turnstile challenge response (status 403 / "Just a moment...").
- `login_required/page.html`: Portal authentication challenge with password input requiring operator session.
